name: rocuronium
description: Drive this Mac without taking the cursor: read, click, type, and scroll any app, with evidence.
long_description:
Rocuronium lets an agent see and operate macOS through accessibility and per-process posted events, so the human keeps their cursor, their focus, and a kill switch (Ctrl+Option+Shift+Escape). Every acting tool returns a verdict (confirmed, noEffect, unverifiable) from what observably changed, because accessibility APIs routinely report success for actions that did nothing.

This bundle is the MCP server: the signed, notarized `rocuronium` CLI from the Rocuronium release. It speaks to the Rocuronium menu bar app, which holds the Accessibility and Screen Recording grants, so the app must be installed and running: `brew install kageroumado/tap/rocuronium`, or the disk image from https://kagerou.glass/get/rocuronium.
